findings.detail: The rate-fill warning is counting unfunded delayed-draw and revolver commitment rows where the SOI source itself reports dashes for reference rate, interest rate, and par amount.

rationale: False alarm. Targeted source rows show the funded term loans have populated reference and interest rates, but the flagged missing-rate pattern localizes to unfunded/negative carrying delayed-draw and revolver rows whose source Interest Rate and Reference Rate cells are '-' and whose related unfunded commitments are disclosed separately. The extracted blank interest_rate therefore matches the raw source for these rows; the check is over-scoping rate-fill expectations to unfunded commitment/negative-balance rows rather than exposing a missing source rate.
